## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the gray bottle for holding drinks and shake it.

Task description: The target is the gray beverage bottle lying horizontally on the right side of the table, in front of the brown can. Lift it off the table and shake it.

Success criteria: The gray beverage bottle has been picked up and shaken, and remains clearly above the table with visible clearance at completion.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the flatter areas on opposite sides around the middle of the bottle body, with the fingers closing toward each other perpendicular to its long axis. Avoid the neck step and smooth rounded base to reduce slipping.
- Consider approaching from above the middle of the bottle body, with an opening slightly wider than the grasp width, leaving room for the orange object near the neck and the watering can on the right to avoid collisions.
- Before closing, use a side view to confirm the fingers enclose the bottle and the pads can contact both sides. Avoid relying on image overlap while actually pressing on top and rolling it away.
- Keep the gripper closed while shaking and use small back-and-forth motions in open space with clearance for both bottle ends. If the body slips against the pads, reduce amplitude and acceleration to avoid throwing it free.
